objective: From a public page, reach the rendered login form before manual credential entry.
nonGoals: Do not enter credentials or bypass provider restrictions.
Do not replace the existing browser owner.
Do not count an open tab or HTTP 200 as a completed login journey.

criteria.rendered-login: The intended sign-in form is visible after an actual navigation action.
criteria.manual-boundary: No credentials were entered and automatic capture stops at takeover.
